## Featured Projects

### 1. Tagtics
Multi-tenant UI feedback SaaS. Users click any element on any web app and submit contextual feedback. PostgreSQL RLS enforces tenant isolation.
- **Stack**: React, Supabase, PostgreSQL, RLS, TypeScript
- **Live**: https://www.tagtics.online
- **Source**: https://github.com/tagtics/tagtics-frontend

### 2. Green Power India
End-to-end corporate platform for a sustainable energy company.
- **Stack**: Next.js 15, React 19, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS
- **Live**: https://greenpowerindia.com/

### 3. Ever-Gauzy
Open-source contributions to a large NestJS/Angular enterprise ERP (Nx monorepo), including authentication UI improvements.
- **Stack**: NestJS, Angular, TypeScript, Nx, CQRS
- **Live**: https://app.gauzy.co/#/auth/login
- **Source**: https://github.com/ever-co/ever-gauzy

### 4. Fashion Studio
Production e-commerce backend on AWS EC2 with Nginx reverse proxy and Razorpay payment webhooks.
- **Stack**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, AWS EC2, Nginx
- **Source**: https://github.com/rishi-rj-s/RSBackend
